scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n bridge,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @codex-pad/bridge" "npm run dev --workspace @codex-pad/web"
scripts.codex-pad: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @codex-pad/bridge && node apps/bridge/dist/cli.js
scripts.setup: npm run build:packages && tsx apps/bridge/src/cli.ts setup
scripts.doctor: npm run build:packages && tsx apps/bridge/src/cli.ts doctor
scripts.fixture:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @codex-pad/web && tsx apps/web/e2e/fixture-server.ts
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run check --workspace @codex-pad/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @codex-pad/codex-desktop && npm run check --workspace @codex-pad/drawing && npm run check --workspace @codex-pad/review && npm run check --workspace @codex-pad/site-review && npm run check --workspace @codex-pad/web && npm run check --workspace @codex-pad/bridge
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @codex-pad/protocol && npm run build --workspace @codex-pad/codex-desktop && npm run build --workspace @codex-pad/drawing && npm run build --workspace @codex-pad/review && npm run build --workspace @codex-pad/site-review
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @codex-pad/web && npm run build --workspace @codex-pad/bridge
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.start: npm run build && node apps/bridge/dist/cli.js start
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run audit:release
